canada.summary: Matthew Collins, who lives in Gander, is facing eight charges. They include possessing explosives and prohibited weapons, uttering threats and intimidation by using violence.

canada.title: N.L.’s presumed oldest resident turns 111 this weekend, and she’s as sharp as ever

canada.title: 'We are sorry': Rocks found in restaurant burritos in Alberta
canada.summary: BarBurrito issued an apology to its customers after pea-sized stones were found in some of its burritos at restaurants in Alberta. The company says the rocks came from a particular brand of beans that it is no longer using.

canada.title: Judge awards damages to both sides in lawsuit after neighbours' dispute over loose dogs 'spun out of control'

canada.title: Big Brothers Big Sisters launches 'Start Small' campaign to recruit more male mentors
